text: {"reply":"Please don't drive the car. Grinding from a wheel with a brake warning light may mean it's unsafe, and I can't tell you what's wrong or that it's safe to drive. If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 911. My colleague's earlier suggestion to drive it to Vaughan was wrong. Please arrange a tow or a ride instead. I'm passing this to a person now, so they can review it urgently and help with the tow and the warranty question. Are you somewhere safe right now?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer reports grinding from the front right wheel and a brake warning light on a 2021 Meridian Arbor, and asks if they can keep driving. They also want to know if it is covered by warranty. Customer is not verified and no tools were used. A previous message wrongly suggested driving to the branch; the customer was told not to drive the car. Needs urgent follow-up on a tow, an inspection and the warranty question.","policy_rules_cited":["P07","P14","P13"]}
